summary: Iteration 31 breakpoint validation (md->lg swap in Navbar/MobileMenu). 5/6 requested checks PASS but the PRIMARY requirement — desktop nav on ONE LINE at 1440x900 authed admin — FAILS. The breakpoint bump only addressed the 768-1023 zone (which now correctly uses the mobile drawer); the pre-existing 1440 admin cramping flagged in iteration 30 is unchanged. Test details: (1) 360x760 unauth: hamburger visible, desktop nav hidden — PASS. (2) 900x900 unauth (previously buggy zone): hamburger visible, desktop nav hidden — PASS (fix confirmed here). (3) 1023x900 unauth: hamburger visible, desktop nav hidden — PASS. (4) 1024x900 unauth: hamburger HIDDEN, desktop nav visible (nav-login rendered) — PASS. (5) 1440x900 unauth: hamburger hidden, desktop nav visible — PASS. (6) 1440x900 authed admin (admin@generaquiz.fr): desktop nav is STILL wrapping/clipping — FAIL. Nav element measured height=136px (should be ~48), uniqueTops=[13,43,47,52,55,57,60] (7 different top offsets = multi-line wrap inside each link), rect.right=1738.8 while viewport=1440 (overflows right by ~299px), and 'Signalements' visually clips off the right edge. Regression checks OK: at 360x760 authed admin the mobile drawer opens and shows all 9 expected testids (mobile-nav-dashboard, atelier, leagues, progression, challenges, earn-credits, account, admin-analytics, logout).

ui_bugs.issue: Desktop nav STILL wraps labels ('Quiz du Jour' -> 3 lines, 'Mes quiz' -> 2, 'Défi famille' -> 2, 'Mon compte' -> 2) AND overflows right edge by ~299px, clipping 'Signalements'. The md->lg breakpoint change (this iteration) only moved the tablet range 768-1023 to the mobile drawer; it did NOT reduce the number of desktop links or their sizing, so the 1440 admin nav is just as cramped as in iteration 30. Root cause: admin sees 10 desktop links (Quiz du Jour, Mes quiz, Atelier, Ligues, Niv, Défi famille, Crédits, Mon compte, Analytics, Promos, Signalements) + Quitter button + SeniorModeToggle — combined intrinsic width ~1467px which exceeds any reasonable header width (max-w-7xl = 1280px, viewport 1440px). Suggested fixes: (a) collapse admin links (Analytics/Promos/Signalements) into a single 'Admin ▾' dropdown, (b) icon-only rendering for Ligues/Niv/Crédits/Mon compte on 1024-1279, (c) reduce label lengths ('Défi famille' -> 'Défi', 'Mon compte' -> icon), or (d) push the hamburger threshold up to xl (1280px) so 1024-1279 also uses the drawer.

action_items: The md->lg breakpoint swap does NOT solve the desktop-admin-cramping bug reported in iteration 30. Choose one of: (a) group admin links into a dropdown, (b) shorten/iconify labels, or (c) raise the desktop-nav breakpoint to xl (Tailwind 1280px) with `hidden xl:flex` on Navbar nav and `xl:hidden` on MobileMenu wrapper — but note even at 1440 the intrinsic content width (~1467px) still exceeds the max-w-7xl container (1280px), so raising to xl alone won't fully fix it: you still need dropdown/label trimming.
Retest at 1440x900 admin after the follow-up fix — target: nav height ~48px on a single line, no horizontal overflow, 'Signalements' fully visible and clickable.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar.jsx line 17 (`hidden lg:flex`) correctly moved the split to 1024px, matching MobileMenu.jsx line 29 (`lg:hidden`). Class swap itself is correct and consistent.

Navbar.jsx admin block (lines 48-54) unconditionally renders 3 extra full-text labels ('Analytics', 'Promos', 'Signalements') AFTER already-crowded auth links — the root cause of the 1440 cramping. Recommend refactoring to an 'Admin ▾' dropdown menu component.
Navbar auth branch (lines 32-47) mixes text-lg (px-4 py-2) and text-base (px-3 py-2) sizes without a consistent scale — makes wrapping unpredictable. Standardize spacing/typography for nav items.

The parent flex container (`max-w-7xl mx-auto ... flex items-center justify-between`) does not use `overflow-hidden` or `flex-wrap`, so overflowing children silently spill past the viewport edge (which is exactly what's happening with 'Signalements').

success_rate.frontend: 83% (5 of 6 requirements pass; core desktop-admin 1440 requirement fails)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 31: md->lg breakpoint swap confirmed at 5 viewports (360, 900, 1023, 1024, 1440 unauth) — those are all correct. The 900-1023 buggy zone is now fixed (uses mobile drawer). BUT the primary user-facing requirement — 'nav renders on ONE LINE with no wrapping or clipping at 1440x900 authed admin' — is NOT met. Nav still 136px tall with 7 wrap-tops and overflows right by ~299px; 'Signalements' clips. Requires an actual structural fix (admin dropdown, icon labels, or breakpoint bump to xl combined with content reduction), not just a breakpoint swap. Mobile drawer at 360 authed admin is fully functional (all 9 testids visible).
rca of the issue: Root cause: at 1440x900 authenticated as admin, the desktop nav contains ~13 flex children (Quiz du Jour, Mes quiz, Atelier, Ligues, Niv, Défi famille, Crédits+badge, Mon compte, Analytics, Promos, Signalements, Quitter, SeniorModeToggle). Their combined intrinsic width (~1467px) exceeds the max-w-7xl container (1280px) AND the viewport (1440px). The flex-row parent doesn't wrap, so items squeeze via text wrapping inside each link (px-4 py-2 items become 2-3 lines tall) AND the tail (Signalements + Quitter + toggle) overflows past the right edge. The md->lg breakpoint change in this iteration only affects viewports < 1024px; it has zero effect at 1440px. Mitigation: refactor admin links into an 'Admin' dropdown OR reduce label verbosity (icon-only for Ligues/Niv/Crédits/Mon compte) OR raise the desktop threshold and combine with content reduction.
